subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 25, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 25, 2026

As we continue to push forward with the development of AcreetionOS, we're excited to share the latest updates from our community and team. Our community has been actively contributing to the project, and we're grateful for their dedication and enthusiasm.

In recent news, the AcreetionOS community has been featured in several articles, including a piece on BetaNews discussing our user-friendly interface and ease of use. This is a testament to the hard work of our team and the growing popularity of our project. We're thrilled to see AcreetionOS being recognized as a viable alternative to Windows 10/11.

We're also excited to announce the release of the latest Arch Linux-based distribution, Garuda Linux "Temeraire," which features the Linux Kernel 7.2. This is a significant development in the Linux community, and we're proud to be a part of it.

On a more personal note, our team members have been making significant contributions to the project. Natalie has been working on the bash2bat conversion script, which is now available on GitHub. This script is a valuable tool for developers and users alike, and we're grateful for Natalie's dedication to making AcreetionOS more accessible.

Darren has also been busy, working on the immutable A/B profile and versioned release automation in the acreetionos-code/acreetionos-immutable repository. This is a crucial step in ensuring the stability and security of our distribution.

In other news, the AcreetionOS community has been active on social media, with several members sharing their experiences and tips on using the distribution. We're grateful for the community's engagement and look forward to seeing more contributions in the future.

We're also proud to announce that AcreetionOS has received a significant boost in funding, with a massive $8M investment from Linuxiac. This will enable us to continue developing and improving our distribution, and we're excited to see what the future holds.

As always, we're committed to transparency and open communication. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitHub repository.

Finally, we'd like to thank our community for their continued support and enthusiasm. We're proud to be a part of the Linux community, and we look forward to continuing to work together to create a better, more secure, and more user-friendly distribution.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
